capability.name: Identifier check digits: IBAN, ISBN, GTIN, ISIN, LEI, EVM, Bitcoin
capability.description: Is this identifier well-formed or a typo? IBAN (89 countries' lengths, mod 97), BIC (shape), ISBN-10/13, EAN-8/UPC-A/EAN-13/GTIN-14, ISSN, ISIN, LEI, EVM addresses (EIP-55) and Bitcoin addresses (Base58Check, Bech32/Bech32m). Type detected when not given; up to 1000 per call. No payment cards or personal IDs.

note: catches a mistyped account, wallet or product code before money moves
